instruction.text: Leah is a fan of magic and wants to sign up on a social media site. What must Leah absolutely do first before she signs up on social media?

b: Tell all her friends about it.

feedback.end: Always ask your parents if you’re allowed to sign up on social media. They can also help you create your profile.

instruction.text: Leah wants to choose her username. Which username could Leah choose to give out as little information about herself as possible?

feedback.end: Your username should preferably not be your real name or contain any personal information. It should be a nickname instead.

instruction.text: Next, Leah wants to pick a profile picture. She wants to show that she’s a fan of magic but she doesn’t want to show her face. Which profile picture could work well?

feedback.end: On social media sites, you shouldn’t use a real photo of yourself as a profile picture.

instruction.text: Leah wants to fill out her profile some more, but she should be careful not to include any personal information. What counts as personal information that you should not put on your profile?
